items.exampleEn: Nobody knows with certainty what will happen tomorrow.
items.exampleZh: 沒有人能確定明天會發生什麼事。

items.exampleEn: We got a polite refusal from the hotel.
items.exampleZh: 我們收到飯店客氣的拒絕。

items.exampleEn: Stop talking nonsense and help me clean up.
Each person in the group shared a different viewpoint.
items.exampleZh: 小組裡每個人都分享了不同的觀點。

items.exampleEn: It's unbelievable that she finished the book in one day.
items.exampleZh: 她一天就讀完那本書，真令人難以置信。

items.exampleEn: The story takes place in an imaginary country.
items.exampleZh: 這個故事發生在一個想像中的國家。

items.exampleEn: The ending of this game is always unpredictable.
items.exampleZh: 這個遊戲的結局總是難以預測。
清楚的說明可以避免誤會。

items.sentenceEn: Sorry, it was just a misunderstanding.

items.audioEn: The team's refusal to play in the rain surprised the fans.
items.audioZh: 球隊拒絕在雨中比賽，讓球迷很驚訝。
options: The team wouldn't play in the rain
The team lost by ten points
The game started an hour late
The fans played in the rain

items.sentenceEn: From my viewpoint, the plan costs too much.
items.sentenceZh: 從我的觀點來看，這個計畫花費太高。

items.sentenceEn: His story sounds like nonsense to me.
items.sentenceZh: 他的故事在我聽來像是胡說八道。

items.stemEn: My little sister talks to her ____ friend, who lives in her toy house.
items.stemZh: 我妹妹會跟她想像中的朋友說話，那位朋友住在她的玩具屋裡。

items.stemEn: There is no ____ that the bus will come on time.
items.stemZh: 公車會不會準時到，並不確定。

items.passageEn: Last week, there was a misunderstanding between my best friend and me. I told her that her new haircut was unbelievable. I meant it was amazing, but she thought I was saying it looked strange. She said my words were nonsense and stopped talking to me. Her refusal to answer my messages made me sad. My mom said that people's feelings can be unpredictable, and that I should try to see things from my friend's viewpoint. So I wrote her a letter to explain what I really meant. I also drew a funny imaginary animal to make her laugh. When she read it, a faint smile appeared on her face. It worked! Now I know with certainty that clear words are important.
items.passageZh: 上週，我和我最好的朋友之間發生了一個誤會。我跟她說她的新髮型「令人難以置信」。我的意思是很棒，她卻以為我在說看起來很怪。她說我講的話是胡說八道，然後就不跟我說話了。她拒絕回我的訊息，讓我很難過。媽媽說人的情緒很難預測，我應該試著從朋友的觀點看事情。所以我寫了一封信給她，解釋我真正的意思。我還在信裡畫了一隻好笑的想像中的動物逗她笑。她讀信時，臉上露出淡淡的微笑。成功了！現在我很確定，把話說清楚非常重要。

options: 作者在大家面前取笑她的衣服
以為作者說她的髮型很怪
作者弄壞了她的新手機

referenceEn: He runs at an unbelievable speed.

rubricZh: unbelievable 表示「難以置信的」，例如 an unbelievable speed 等說法
